report.summary: 4 reviewed findings: high-severity trace_id mismatch and offload_runner exception handling need evidence; medium-severity batch size validation and mutable env isolation need fixes.
risks: Without explicit trace_id passing, intents may be misattributed across traces.
Unhandled exceptions from offload_runner could cascade and break attempt recording.
Large batches may cause silent timeouts or overflow in projection worker or wiki links.
Mutable dict returned by council_env could be accidentally mutated, affecting subprocess environments.
todos: Inspect TASKS list in tasks.py for trace_id field.
Check all call sites of record_intent for explicit trace_id argument.
Inspect offload_runner implementation for possible exceptions.
Check if run_attempt or _recording_runner catch exceptions from offload_runner.
Search for cross-module validation of batch sizes (grep for 'batch' and 'limit').
List all callers of council_env and verify none mutate the result.

items.title: Verify trace_id in task shapes and record_intent calls
items.why_now: Misattributed intents could corrupt trace provenance; high severity.

steps.do: Inspect TASKS list in daedalus/tasks.py to check if trace_id is present in each task shape.
Check all call sites of record_intent in daedalus/ledger.py and other files to see if trace_id is explicitly passed.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'record_intent' daedalus/ -- and inspect each call for trace_id argument

items.assumption: Files daedalus/tasks.py and daedalus/ledger.py exist with the referenced functions.

items.title: Inspect offload_runner for exceptions and verify error handling in callers
items.why_now: Unhandled exceptions from offload_runner could cascade and break attempt recording; high severity.

steps.do: Inspect offload_runner implementation (grep for 'def offload_runner') and list possible exceptions it can raise.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def offload_runner' daedalus/ -- then check function body for raise statements

steps.do: Check if run_attempt or _recording_runner catch exceptions from offload_runner.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'except' daedalus/runner.py -- and verify except clauses cover offload_runner calls

items.assumption: offload_runner is defined in some file under daedalus/; daedalus/runner.py exists and contains run_attempt and _recording_runner.

items.title: Add cross-module batch size validation
items.why_now: Large batches can cause timeout or overflow in downstream modules without feedback; medium severity.

steps.do: Search for any cross-module validation of batch sizes (grep for 'batch' and 'limit' in the codebase). If none found, add validation at the entry point of batch processing.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'batch' daedalus/ -- and grep -rn 'limit' daedalus/ -- then inspect relevant files

items.assumption: The codebase has batch processing entry points; files are under daedalus/.

items.title: Protect council_env return value from mutation
items.why_now: Mutable dict returned by council_env could be accidentally mutated, affecting subprocess environments; medium severity.

steps.do: List all callers of council_env and verify none mutate the result. If any mutate, fix by returning a copy or freezing the dict.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'council_env' daedalus/ -- then inspect each call site

items.assumption: council_env is defined somewhere under daedalus/; callers are in the same directory.
